memberCap: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} members. The Word document lists more.

cavLogin: Two login event types ('auth.user.login' and 'login') exist and may record the same sign-in, so sign-in days is the safer frequency measure than sign-ins.
cavTime: Time-in-app and page views are not tracked, so they are not reported.
cavFlags: Profile flags 'profile complete' and 'survey submitted' are unreliable; the PRISM request list is the better source.
cavLumen: Excluded: {{count}} automated 'Lumen moment delivered' system events, which are not member actions.
cavRoster: Only the first {{cap}} profiles are reported.
cavEvents: Activity is capped at the most recent {{cap}} events per source; earlier counts understate.
cavPrism: PRISM requests are capped at the most recent {{cap}}.
